title: The strategic capacity gate counts finished projects, so an entity that has held max_active_projects projects can never start a new kind of project
summary: One live-project predicate for the capacity gate, the bandwidth trim, CapacityEnforcementPhase and the guild readers; finished projects no longer count; fatigue projects now start; eat/sleep unchanged at 0 (hunger target held for SURV-06); divergence 2.77, STRAT-278; large disclosed re-baseline
